baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ إِلَّا اللَّمَمَ ... اتَّقَى
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah maps a moral field by kinds of movement: deliberate side-distance from grave and boundary-breaking wrong, an admitted zone of near contact, and renewed self-protective caution. Goodness is therefore a practiced boundary relation rather than a claim of untouched purity.

activation_trace.role: Keeping something aside supplies the deliberate distancing action that governs the grave field.
The major-offense branch gives the first object of that distancing its juridical weight.
Exceeding a proper bound makes indecency a breach rather than merely a disfavored item.
Near approach and alighting make the exception a contact-zone within the avoidance profile.
Placing the self in protective caution turns taqwa into an ongoing response after proximity.

changed_reading.before: The ayah classifies good people as those free of serious wrongdoing apart from a small-sin allowance.
changed_reading.after: The ayah depicts goodness as active boundary management: grave excess is kept to the side, near or brief contact is admitted, and the person returns to protective caution without claiming purity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ ... أَنشَأَكُم ... أَجِنَّةٌ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship contributes nurture and completion, breadth contributes capacity to contain, and forgiveness contributes protection from consequence. The origin sequence places this mercy around creatures being brought forth, concealed, borne, and grown, so forgiveness reads as developmental room for repair rather than erasure of the lapse.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make the Lord's relation to the imperfect creature developmental.
Capacity to bear or contain supplies room in which repair can occur.
Forgiving while shielding from consequence supplies the protective operation inside that room.
Bringing into being frames the addressees as made rather than self-grounded.
The fetus hidden in the womb supplies an unfinished, protected stage of creaturely life.
The belly as an interior enclosure gives the developmental process a containing space.
The mother as bearer and nurturer provides the immediate creaturely analogue of sustained formation.

changed_reading.before: Vast forgiveness is a large allowance granted after isolated lapses.
changed_reading.after: Vast forgiveness is the nurturing Lord's capacious protective work around creatures still being formed; it shelters consequence enough for completion and repair without calling the lapse unreal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ ... فَلَا تُزَكُّوا أَنفُسَكُمْ ... هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اتَّقَى
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated divine knowing brackets concealed origin, inwardness, and the prohibition of self-purification. Since the self contains hidden intent and self-regard, its declaration of its own rectitude confuses a desired identity with the disclosure and discrimination that genuine knowledge requires.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure of a thing supplies the competence claimed twice for God around the prohibition.
Covering and concealment make human beginnings unavailable to self-inspection.
Hidden inward reality extends concealment from the womb to the person's interior truth.
Purity and rectitude identify the verdict humans are forbidden to confer on themselves.
Inner thought and hidden intent identify evidence the judging self cannot fully expose.
Self-regard supplies the motive that can bias a verdict of personal purity.

changed_reading.before: The command simply forbids boasting because God knows who is pious.
changed_reading.after: Self-purification is an epistemic overreach: a concealed and interested self cannot reliably disclose and certify its own rectitude, while the repeated Knower can distinguish actual protective conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier gaze that neither inclines away nor exceeds the limit supplies two failures on either side of disciplined orientation. Placed beside lamam as near approach, it distinguishes contact with a boundary from settled deviation or overflow across it.

activation_trace.role: Near approach supplies proximity without by itself specifying a crossed limit.
Exceeding the proper bound supplies the stronger breach from which near approach can be distinguished.
Inclining from straightness supplies one directional failure that disciplined sight avoids.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience supplies the overflow failure at the other edge.

structural_cues: 53:17 coordinates two negated failures of sight, while 53:32 places lamam inside an otherwise active avoidance profile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near approach, directional deviation, and limit-exceeding; I infer a graded movement model in which contact need not become settled breach. A live alternative is that lamam is only a conventional minor-sin class, not a phase on this spatial continuum.

changed_reading.before: Lamam is a static exception on a list of prohibited acts.
changed_reading.after: Lamam can mark boundary contact that has not become a new direction or an overflowing course, preserving a morally serious distinction between encounter, deviation, and settled excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first exposes names conferred without authority, then conjecture followed in place of truth, then the limit of human knowledge against the Lord's superior discrimination. The focus command applies that same epistemic critique inward: calling the self pure can be another unsupported naming act.

activation_trace.role: Purity and rectitude provide the status-name the self is tempted to confer.
Disclosure-based knowledge reserves the final discrimination for the repeated divine Knower.
A name as signification supplies the act of assigning an identity that may outrun its warrant.
Doubt and supposition supply the weak evidence from which an unwarranted verdict can be built.
Limited human knowledge followed by the Lord's knowing of straying and guidance supplies the immediate epistemic template repeated in the focus.

structural_cues: 53:23-30 moves from unauthorized names through repeated conjecture to the limit of their knowledge and the Lord's doubled discrimination; 53:32 repeats the doubled divine-knowing frame around self-purification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unsupported naming, conjecture, limited knowledge, and divine discrimination; I infer that self-acquittal repeats this error with the self as its object. The narrower alternative is a prohibition only of public boasting, not of inwardly settled self-verdicts.

changed_reading.after: Do not manufacture a moral identity by naming the self pure from conjectural access to it; self-acquittal belongs to the same economy of labels that the surah has already detached from truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding recompense is tied to intended work and to those who do good; the focus relative clause then characterizes a people who avoid grave wrong yet still have lamam under vast forgiveness. Goodness is thus rendered as a mercy-exposed practice, not immaculate moral substance.

activation_trace.role: Active keeping-aside supplies the characteristic practice attached to the doers of good.
Approaching a minor sin prevents the characterized group from becoming a class of flawless beings.
Forgiving and shielding from consequence makes mercy constitutive of their good profile.
Answering action with its recompense supplies the evaluative frame into which the focus clause enters.
Intended action makes evaluation practical rather than essentialist.
Doing what is good names the group whose actual moral texture the focus can specify.

structural_cues: 53:31 ends with those who do good and the best return; 53:32 opens with a matching relative clause before introducing lamam and forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense for works, the doers of good, and an adjacent relative clause; I infer that the focus clause characterizes that group. The syntax could instead be heard as a looser apposition, but the changed moral profile remains locally available.

changed_reading.before: Those rewarded as good are presumed morally clean, with forgiveness added for exceptional defects.
changed_reading.after: The doers of good are recognizable by sustained avoidance while remaining exposed to near or minor lapses and therefore constituted, not merely excused, by vast forgiveness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus figure gives little and then stops, yet is posed as though possessing unseen knowledge and sight. This converts the ban on self-purification from general modesty into a test of evidentiary mismatch: interrupted conduct cannot certify a completed hidden identity.

activation_trace.role: Hidden intent locates the unobserved identity that a person may prematurely certify.
Rectitude supplies the completed status that partial action cannot establish.
A little giving followed by stoppage supplies visibly truncated conduct.
What is concealed from eyes supplies the inaccessible domain about which the figure acts certain.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the ironically asserted access that would be needed to certify the hidden.

structural_cues: 53:33-35 follows the focus with a turner-away whose small gift terminates and whose alleged access to the unseen is questioned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies incomplete giving and a sarcastic question about seeing the unseen; I infer that this sequence exemplifies the evidentiary failure behind self-certification. It may instead target one miser independently of the focus prohibition.

changed_reading.before: Self-praise is objectionable mainly because it sounds arrogant.
changed_reading.after: A person cannot infer a finished righteous identity from a favorable fragment of conduct, especially when the continuation and hidden motive remain unseen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence makes burdens nontransferable, gives each person only purposeful striving, exposes that striving to view, and answers it fully. Read back into earth-and-womb origin, common creaturely dependence strips inherited rank without stripping agency: neither pedigree nor self-label transfers moral standing; a lived trajectory remains answerable.

activation_trace.role: The hidden fetus supplies a dependent beginning before any owned moral performance.
The mother-source as origin supplies inherited location and lineage from which status might wrongly be inferred.
The heavy carried load supplies the moral burden that cannot migrate between persons.
Purposeful movement toward a goal supplies the individual's unfolding moral trajectory.
Showing and making visible supplies eventual disclosure of the trajectory hidden from present self-verdict.
Recompense answering action supplies the consequence of that disclosed trajectory.

structural_cues: 53:38-41 forms a tight sequence from nontransferable burden through individual striving, its future exposure, and full recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dependent origin, nontransferable burden, individual striving, disclosure, and recompense; I infer a contrast between unchosen origin and owned trajectory. The live alternative is that the origin clause teaches humility only and does not directly address inherited moral rank.

changed_reading.before: Earth and fetal origin merely humble everyone before the divine judge.
changed_reading.after: Common dependent origin cancels pedigree-based purity, while the later nontransferable and eventually visible striving preserves personal agency; mercy and accountability coexist without turning either into inherited essence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later creation sequence moves from deliberate creation through a fluid drop to another origination. It extends the focus's earth-to-fetus memory into serial authored stages, making self-purification a premature freezing of a creature whose identity and outcome remain open under divine re-creation.

activation_trace.role: Being brought into existence supplies the first explicit authored stage in the focus.
The concealed fetus supplies a visibly unfinished stage rather than a final identity.
Growth and increase let the negated self-purification resonate with a process not yet complete.
Creative bringing-forth assigns authorship of form and state beyond the self.
Fluid ranging from drop to semen supplies a materially minimal and transitional origin.
A further bringing into being extends creaturely development beyond the presently judged stage.

structural_cues: 53:45-47 sequences creation, the reproductive drop, and the other origination, echoing 53:32's created-from-earth and fetal stages.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies serial origins and another origination; I infer ontological non-finality as a reason not to issue a final purity verdict now. The alternative is that the later sequence concerns bodily resurrection only, without implying moral maturation.

changed_reading.before: The origin reminder lowers pride by recalling lowly biological beginnings.
changed_reading.after: The origin reminder also keeps identity temporally open: one stage of a repeatedly originated creature cannot declare itself the finished pure product.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close contrasts diversion and a raised head with lowering and prostration. Read against self-purification and taqwa, the contrast translates moral status into bodily direction: self-elevation gives way to a protective reorientation that lowers itself before God.

activation_trace.role: Self-regard supplies the inward elevation behind a claim of purity.
Protective self-caution supplies a dynamic alternative to elevated self-description.
Diversion and heedlessness supply the inattentive stance from which the close turns away.
Raising the head gives self-elevation a concrete posture.
Lowering and submission supply the corrective bodily direction.
Bowing the head directly reverses the raised-head image and enacts relinquished self-certification.

structural_cues: 53:61's participial stance is immediately answered by the final imperatives to prostrate and worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heedless diversion, raised-head and lowered-head branch images, and the focus's self-regard/protective caution; I infer a posture-level reversal of self-purification. Samidun may instead stress distraction without pride, so the elevation link remains abductive.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is a moral quality that one might accurately possess even if one should not boast of it.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa appears as enacted reorientation: the self stops raising and naming itself, turns from heedlessness, and takes the lowered posture that protects its relation to God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant split mapping of the focus's breadth root as clay mixed with straw and then crosses into the ayah's earth and covering language. It remains packet-anchored at the exact focus occurrence and forms a coherent material mechanism, but downstream prose must label it an exploratory analogy, never a lexical gloss of وَاسِعُ.

activation_trace.role: Clay mixed with straw supplies an unlikely composite whose unlike fragile constituents become one workable material.
Soft fertile ground anchors the composite image in the ayah's explicit earthly origin.
Protective covering turns the earthen composite into a sheltering rather than merely adhesive analogy.

changed_reading.before: Breadth of forgiveness means only that many sins can fit within a large quantitative allowance.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, forgiveness can be imagined as an earthen composite that holds frail, heterogeneous creaturely matter together into a protective whole while it is repaired.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it borrows the branch images of leading something alongside and an animal's pain-guarded gait, both distant from ordinary moral exposition. It remains anchored to the focus's avoidance, near approach, and taqwa construction and yields a causal kinesthetic model; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory model of managing recurrent vulnerability, not as the direct meaning of the words.

activation_trace.role: Leading or keeping something alongside supplies active management of a danger that remains near but does not take the lead.
Near approach supplies the recurring vulnerability that cannot honestly be narrated as total absence.
A guarded gait shaped by hoof pain supplies careful movement adapted to known weakness.

changed_reading.before: Avoidance requires complete separation from every morally dangerous proximity.
changed_reading.after: As a kinesthetic analogy, the guarded person may keep a recurring vulnerability alongside and adjust the gait around it, refusing both surrender to it and the false claim that it is absent.

strongest_changes: Lamam became near contact inside a boundary practice rather than a loophole in a purity class.
The naming-conjecture-knowledge sequence turned self-purification into unauthorized moral naming, not merely bad manners.
The immediate recompense context made the doers of good mercy-dependent practitioners rather than flawless selves.
The burden-and-striving sequence separated unchosen dependent origin from nontransferable, eventually visible agency.
The final raised-head and prostration contrast translated taqwa from a status label into lowered embodied reorientation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sustained several mechanisms at once: graded boundary movement, protective developmental mercy, hidden-self epistemology, accountable trajectory, and bodily humility. Non-dominant and form-distant branches also opened material and kinesthetic outliers without displacing the stronger readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Lamam may denote near contact, a conventional minor-sin class, episodic recurrence, or more than one of these at once.
The link from those who do good in 53:31 to the relative clause in 53:32 is strong by adjacency but not the only possible syntactic hearing.
Serial creaturely origins may support moral non-finality, or may function only as humility and resurrection evidence.
The raised-head/prostration reversal is branch-grounded but remains an abductive reading of the closing posture sequence.
